name: QuickTime text without {QTtext}, with a fraction at the time scale, a swapped sample and a time of 100000 hours

strict.error: The file does not start with {QTtext}.

warnings.message: The file does not start with {QTtext}. The parser read it as QuickTime text.
The timestamp "[00:00:03.45]" counts 45 units, but the time scale is 30 per second. The parser added them to the seconds.
The time "100000:00:00.00" is not below 100000 hours.
The cue ends at 3 s, before it starts at 4.5 s. The parser swapped the times.
